name: JW Marriott Hotel Bogota
positioning: Luxury hotel in Bogota's financial district in Chapinero, steps from Zona G and Zona T, with the Presence spa and an indoor lap pool
best_for: Travelers who want to walk to the restaurants and bars of Zona G and Zona T
Guests who want a spa and indoor pool after a day in the city
Travelers looking for a suite with separate living space

facts.text: The hotel is in Bogota's financial district, steps from Zona G and Zona T.
Zona G, near the hotel, is known for its concentration of restaurants offering diverse international cuisines.
The hotel is within walking distance of many restaurants, cafes and bars in Chapinero.
Guest rooms feature soundproof windows and premium linens.
Rooms have spacious bathrooms with walk-in showers and bathtubs.
Suites have separate living, sleeping and dining areas.
The Deluxe Suite has a balcony.
The Executive Lounge offers views and a space designed for relaxation and productivity.
The Presence spa and fitness center includes a pool.
Factory Steak & Lobster is a steakhouse focused on premium cuts and fresh lobster with a curated wine selection.
Circo is a circus-themed restaurant with cozy outdoor spaces, brick-oven pizza and live music from up-and-coming Colombian artists.

highlights.text: The Presence spa uses scents extracted from medicinal plants in its wellness services.
The hotel has a heated indoor lap pool.
The Presidential Suite has expansive living spaces, contemporary design and sweeping city views.
Tanoshii serves fresh sushi with signature cocktails and sake-based drinks.

considerations.text: El Dorado International Airport is about 6 miles from the hotel.
Pets are not allowed at the hotel.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing reflecting the high-end positioning.
